scope: Static boundary review, not compiler/link closure or validated adapters

headers.decision: Transitive memory-manager dependency through buffer-cache headers; do not import emulator address-space singleton.
Transitive memory/signal dependency; no CPU-patch service implemented by graphics.
Replace shader dump and direct-memory settings with explicit immutable compile configuration; disabling direct memory requires its buffer-cache fallback, not a success stub.
Transitive memory manager types; runtime-owned ledger/lease adapter required.
Included by decoder and translator; no Kernel:: call found there in lexical review. Preserve header/ABI until actual compile proves a safe narrower dependency.
Buffer-cache header exposes Core::MemoryManager pointer; host lease boundary required, no second memory manager.
SRT walker registers a fault handler which patches faulting loads; keep unavailable until validated owned-memory access and exception lifecycle exist. Never silently zero invalid guest reads.

additional_sites.observation: GetSharp nested address dereference and tessellation constants pointer need bounded lease-backed snapshots; host callbacks alone do not make these accesses safe.
SRT JIT32MiB plus signal handler registration and fault-load patching require separate ownership/lifetime design.
Buffer-cache constants consumed even in shader-only seed selection.
Non-direct-memory path creates buffer-cache page-table resource.
